stem: A town council selected 500 adult residents at random and asked whether they support extending the hours of the town's public park. Of the 500 residents selected, 40 did not respond, and 276 of the residents who did respond said they support the plan. What percent of the residents who responded said they support the plan?
solution: The number of residents who responded is \(500 - 40 = 460\).
The percent who support the plan is \(\frac{276}{460} = 0.60\), or 60%.
verify:
selected, nonresp, support = 500, 40, 276
resp = selected - nonresp
pct = Rational(support, resp) * 100
assert pct == 60 and Rational(support, selected) * 100 != 60
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [pct]
